name: Orient on the Murder Express
source:
Take the role of a detective stuck on the Murder Express! While on this train you decide to take a nap, but when you wake up you find that someone's been murdered! Now it is up to you to solve it.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2959230/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
扮演一名被困在谋杀快车上的侦探！在这趟火车上，你决定小睡一会儿，但当你醒来时，你发现有人被谋杀了！现在就轮到你来解决它了。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2959230/]Steam[/url]]
